key_concepts: All living things are made of cells
The cell is the smallest unit of life
The Cell Theory has three postulates
Plant cells have a cell wall
Animal cells lack a cell wall
Plant and animal cells share a cell membrane, nucleus, and cytoplasm
Onion epidermis is used to observe plant cells
Cheek cells are used to observe animal cells
Iodine solution stains plant cells for viewing
Methylene blue stains animal cells for viewing
Staining makes cell structures more visible under the microscope
Plant and animal cells differ in shape
